item.title: Driver arrested for DUI after fatal bus crash in Hobart
item.description: A fatal crash involving a bus towing a passenger car, an SUV, and a pickup truck occurred on northbound I-65, resulting in the death of the bus driver and the arrest of the truck driver for operating while intoxicated involving a fatality.

item.title: Plans for ICE office in Carmel
item.description: The Carmel City Council president has confirmed that U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement will establish an office in Carmel. The plan has caused fear and concern among community members, some of whom have coworkers, friends and family members affected by ICE's actions.

item.title: Mirkovic scores 25 points as No. 8 Illinois defeats Indiana Hoosiers
item.description: No. 8 Illinois defeated Indiana 71-51, with David Mirkovic scoring 25 points and Kylan Boswell returning from injury to add 9 points and 7 rebounds.

item.title: Florists’ busiest week of the year, Indianapolis flower shop faces first Valentine’s Day rush
item.description: SoBro Flower Co. in Indianapolis is preparing for its first Valentine's Day, with staff working hard to create beautiful arrangements and ensure they have enough inventory to meet the demand.

item.title: Father and stepmother arrested in death of 11-year-old daughter
item.description: Hendricks County Sheriff's deputies have arrested a father and stepmother after the death of their 11-year-old daughter, who was found unresponsive at their home, on the charge of neglect of a dependent resulting in death.

item.title: ‘Indy Singing Resistance’ group gathers in downtown Indianapolis to sing in support of Minneapolis
item.description: Around 200 people gathered at the South side of the monument circle in Indianapolis to sing in support of Minneapolis and immigrant communities, hoping to spark conversations among people who may not otherwise interact.

item.title: Armed man in custody after pursuit on IU Indy and Purdue Indy’s campus
item.description: Police have taken an armed man into custody who was reported to be inside a parking garage on IU Indy and Purdue Indy's campuses.

item.title: Milder air builds after fog then a few midweek showers | Feb. 15, 2026
item.description: The week ahead will be unusually mild with highs in the 50s and 60s, with a few showers and thunderstorms at times, and the prolonged thaw, elevated river and creek responsiveness, and ongoing potential for ice jam issues.

item.title: Union City School secretary accused of inappropriate relationship with 17-year-old student
item.description: Alicia Hughes, a secretary from Union City Jr./Sr High School, was arrested by Union City Police on five counts of child seduction after evidence was discovered of a sexual relationship with a 17-year-old student and an 18-year-old student from Randolph Eastern School Cooperation.
